data.title: Second Payment Reminder – Dental Invoice (2. Mahnung)
data.summary: Muster Abrechnungszentrum für Zahnärzte GmbH, billing on behalf of the dental practice Dr. Beispielhaus, sent a second payment reminder (2. Mahnung) for a treatment dated 18 May 2026. The outstanding amount is €417.80 (€412.80 invoice plus €5.00 dunning fee), due by 21 August 2026.
data.explanation: This is a second reminder (2. Mahnung) for an unpaid dental invoice, sent by the billing agency that handles payments for your dentist. The stated due date has already passed, so you should pay the outstanding €417.80 as soon as possible to avoid further reminders, added fees, or a court collection process (Mahnverfahren). If you disagree with the invoice, call the number given before paying, as the letter asks you to clarify any objections directly with them first. If the practice already received payment or you dispute the treatment, keep proof of payment or raise it immediately.
data.tax_note: Dental treatment costs can sometimes be claimed as extraordinary medical expenses (außergewöhnliche Belastungen) in the tax return; keep this invoice and proof of payment.
